html:
G'oya

Ulush uchun ikki son kerak: savdoning o'zi va hudud bo'yicha jami. Jamini SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY region) har bir qator yoniga yozadi, keyin oddiy bo'lish va 100 ga ko'paytirish qoladi.

Yechim

SELECT id, region, amount,
       ROUND(100.0 * amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 2) AS pct
FROM sales

Namunada Toshkent jami 1000, shuning uchun uning savdolari 50, 30 va 20 foiz. Buxoroda bitta savdo, u 100 foiz.

Tuzoqlar

Butun sonlarni bo'lish. amount ham, yig'indi ham butun son, PostgreSQL ham, SQLite ham ularni bo'lganda kasr qismini tashlab yuboradi. Namunada hamma foiz butun chiqadi, shuning uchun Run xatoni ko'rsatmaydi. Hududda 1, 1, 1 summali uchta savdo bo'lsa, 100 * 1 / 3 33 beradi, 33.33 emas:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, region, amount,
       ROUND(100 * amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 2) AS pct
FROM sales

100.0 birinchi turishi kerak: 100.0 * amount kasr son bo'ladi va bo'lish ham kasr sonda ketadi. amount / SUM(...) * 100.0 deb yozilsa, butun bo'lish ko'paytirishdan oldin bajariladi va deyarli hamma joyda 0 chiqadi.

OVER () butun kompaniya bo'yicha ulushni beradi, OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY id) esa o'sib boruvchi yig'indiga bo'ladi. Ikkalasi ham boshqa savolga javob.

Boshqa yo'l

Hudud jamilarini GROUP BY bilan alohida hisoblab, savdolarga ulash ham to'g'ri:

SELECT s.id, s.region, s.amount,
       ROUND(100.0 * s.amount / t.total, 2) AS pct
FROM sales s
JOIN (
  SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY region
) t ON t.region = s.region
